limitations: The underlying reports and linked investigative records are not included.

evidence_coverage.rationale: The central finding is accompanied by examination limitations and competing accounts, but the underlying reports are unavailable.

source_traceability.rationale: The article identifies most immediate sources, but some material is relayed through an intermediary and some observers are described collectively.

causal_support.rationale: The article presents unresolved possibilities and does not endorse a causal account.

context_completeness.rationale: The article supplies a timeline and important limitations, but final reports and toxicology results are absent.

framing_uncertainty_separation.rationale: The article distinguishes undetermined findings, attributed possibilities, examination limitations, and competing accounts.

issues.description: The supplied account omits parts of the examination method and the full underlying report.
Collectively described observers provide a competing possibility without enough information to assess how representative it is.

bounded_conclusion: Assuming the reported facts are accurate, the available examinations and competing accounts do not establish a single cause.

structural_assessment.one_sentence: The article supports its central finding with attributed evidence and explicit limitations while stopping short of resolving the uncertainty.
